transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Namaste, main Rakesh Sharma bol raha hoon. Aap kaun? Mujhe English samajh nahi aati. Hindi mein baat kijiye.

Thank you for confirming. I am an automated assistant from Mumbai Bank and I can only speak in English. If you would like, I can arrange a call back from an agent who speaks Hindi. Would you like to request a callback in Hindi? If yes, please let me know your preferred time.
Mujhe turant baat karni hai. Call back ka intezar nahi kar sakta. Aap Hindi mein baat karo.
